'''Nene''' (Japanese: '''少女ネネ''' ''Young Nene'') is a minor recurring character who first appeared in ''[[SM073|Why Not Give Me a Z-Ring Sometime?]]''. In the Japanese version, she and [[Piko]] refer to [[Acerola]] as "Big Sis".

Nene is close friends with Piko. They asked Acerola to read them a story, which she did. They later watched as Acerola was captured by a {{p|Gengar}}.

Nene reappeared in ''[[SM074|Tough Guy Trials!]]'' at Acerola's house alongside Piko.
